author: The Sconi
title: Indian Trail Key Club hosts 'Starry Night' prom for exceptional students
text:
Indian Trail Key Club hosted the “Starry Night” prom for exceptional students in Kenosha Unified School District on April 25. The event brought together attendees from Tremper, Bradford, Indian Trail, and the STEP Program for an evening of dinner, dancing, photos, and other activities.
The prom was planned and hosted by Indian Trail’s Key Club with support from the Educators Rising Club. Organizers said sponsors and supporters included Birchwood Grill, Hometown Meats, Infusino’s Family Restaurant, Paielli’s Bakery, Mason’s Eatery, Ruffolo’s Special Pizza 2, Sunnyside Florist, Ryan Anderson (photographer), Bill Lynch (DJ), The Painted Paper Co., Chef Megan, and staff from various schools.
A special mention was given to Mr. Bill for his role as DJ throughout the night: “A special ‘thank you’ to Mr. Bill for keeping the dance floor moving all night long!”
Indian Trail High School and Academy had the largest number of students among Kenosha County schools in the 2023-24 school year with a total of 2,001 students; this represented a 1.1% increase from the previous year according to the Wisconsin Department of Public Instruction .
Organizers said events like these are important opportunities for community building among exceptional students across multiple schools.
